# Code Anchors: Grooming Sprint Assignments

- `libs/app/src/moves.ts` — the move write, failure causes, the drag marker check, and one write in flight per row with rollback to the saved band

- `backend/internal/handler/sync.go` — returns every assignment with the sync answer and never changes one
- `libs/design-system/README.md` — usage rule 4 names sprint assignments as Raiden data with edit controls
